experiment: Prospective CPU reliability study v1; paired physical-plan replay and executed warm-request policies
timeout_policy: Within each timing phase, stop repeating a physical plan after its first actual timeout/error and explicitly mark later slots unavailable. Do not propagate pilot or paired-profile failures into the separate plain-policy phase. All planned draws and requests remain in denominators.
profile_policy: Complete all new samples/proposals before timings. Deduplicate verified physical plans per query. Session warmup then five blocks of candidate/baseline pairs with seeded random pair and within-pair order. EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS TIMING OFF; median of valid paired execution ratios, except identical physical plans have structural ratio one. Retain raw same-plan pairs as a noise control. Mixed-session/incomplete/clock-invalid pairs are unavailable.
request_policy: Six preselected seed indices and three randomized blocks of seven arms: 1512 planned request slots. Fresh sampling/decoding/planning, pre-execution cost guard and actual ordinary SELECT, post-EXPLAIN validation are inside the request timer. Inputs and BQM are prepared once/query and reported separately. All arms pay their stated plan validation; guarded arms additionally obtain a fresh default estimate. This is validated prepared-input warm-request latency, not a production latency guarantee.
environment_policy: Process-bound sleep inhibition, load admission before pairs/requests/warmups, paired UTC/monotonic clocks, load before/after, local power snapshots. Queue wait excluded from service latency but recorded. Load is a proxy, not hardware isolation. Keep noisy samples and report diagnostics; do not silently redraw.
selection_policy: All twelve original coverage templates; thirty prospective seeds; paired flat/directed proposals share each raw SA sample; policy seeds fixed before new timing. No timing-driven tuning or selection. No QPU, hybrid, full iterative QDBO or equal-compute claim.
